about.title: About GramMitra
about.description: GramMitra is a platform designed to connect people in villages and small towns with trusted local workers. Our goal is to make it simple for users to find skilled services nearby without confusion or delay.
about.mission: We aim to empower local workers by giving them visibility and opportunities, while helping users easily access reliable services like repair, cleaning, and personal assistance.
about.howItWorks: Users can browse services, find workers based on their needs, and book them in just a few clicks. Workers can showcase their skills and get more job opportunities through the platform.
about.vision: Our vision is to build a strong digital bridge between rural talent and everyday needs, creating a trusted ecosystem where both users and workers grow together.
